conversations_memory:
**Work context**

dk is an Associate Data/BI Analyst at Sentient AI (Karachi, Pakistan), working since July 2025, with HBL (Habib Bank Limited) as a flagship client engagement. Their work spans SSRS/Power BI Report Server development querying a Cloudera Impala datalake (Temenos T24 core banking source tables) via SQL Server linked server, banking data modeling, and Self-Service BI architecture (Cloudera + Tabular SSAS + Power BI Report Server). They also contribute to internal initiatives including a finance AI agent suite (built on Anthropic's financial services agent templates) and onboarding/training new team members.

**Personal context**

dk pursues technical certifications independently, having prepared extensively for Microsoft's DP-600 exam, and engages in personal side projects involving Impala/SQL and Informatica-based ETL design outside of work contexts.

**Top of mind**

The most recent and extensive work was a multi-part Excel data analysis workbook classifying banking data attributes (Base vs. Derived, subject area counts, Customer entity tagging) from a Detail tab against an Analysis_Format template — this involved many rounds of precise reconciliation and scope narrowing based on dk's corrections. Just prior to that, dk was building foundational domain knowledge of Pakistani banking lending/trade/treasury portfolios and validating a banking data model (limit/facility/collateral/lien hierarchy) via draw.io diagrams, aimed at integrating new portfolios into an existing prototype data model. Recurring SSRS/SQL troubleshooting continues in parallel, including multi-value parameter handling with linked-server dynamic SQL and VLOOKUP/join optimization work.

**Brief history**

*Recent months*

dk validated a banking account data model (draw.io PDF) with Claude, catching an unverified assumption about table relationships that Claude corrected after reading the embedded diagram XML directly. Troubleshooting continued on SSRS reports using the `EXEC (@query) AT datalake` pattern, including a parameterized monthly report with CTE-based date logic and multi-value "code" parameter handling via VB expressions. A Microsoft Authenticator lockout issue was resolved by identifying the informal Microsoft 365 admin at dk's organization (which has no formal IT department). dk also did SQL/Excel optimization work (UNION ALL for OR-joins, VLOOKUP mapping) and merged/deduplicated banking report task lists, alongside Power BI RLS setup guidance.

*Earlier context*

dk completed an intensive DP-600 (Fabric Analytics Engineer) exam prep session working through practice questions, frequently cross-checking Claude's answers against dump answer keys and instructing Claude to verify against Microsoft Learn documentation rather than rely on training knowledge alone — a strong preference for documentation-backed accuracy over community-voted answers. Related certification study covered SCDs, Direct Lake semantic models, OLS, and DAX optimization. dk also completed their annual appraisal form with Claude's help, carefully distinguishing team vs. solo ownership and correcting generic framing, and built a 30-day SQL/banking training plan and exercises for a new intern at HBL. A personal Impala/SQL side project involved ETL staging design with Informatica as scheduler; dk explicitly instructed that work-related table/schema/column names must never be stored in memory.

*Long-term background*

dk contributed to a finance AI agent suite project, including evaluating open-source LLMs as Claude alternatives for cost reduction, building model/cost comparison spreadsheets, and designing multi-agent use cases (Market Researcher, Model Builder, Statement Auditor, Valuation Reviewer, KYC Screener) for pitching to Pakistani financial clients (e.g., Meezan Bank) using publicly available data (PSX, SECP, SBP). dk also built a UI platform showcasing these agents for internal demo purposes, worked on a credit card hyperpersonalization/gamification product plan with SBP compliance considerations, and explored banking customer behavioral segmentation datasets. Earlier technical work included SSAS Tabular troubleshooting (service account permissions, firewall/port configuration) and building a financial analytics training workshop deck with P&L data.
